policy.first_stably_faster_condition: p_value_one_sided <= alpha AND every one of the six paired differences is strictly below -practical_tolerance_ms
policy.second_stably_faster_condition: p_value_one_sided <= alpha AND every one of the six paired differences is strictly above practical_tolerance_ms
policy.test: one-sided exact paired sign-flip permutation test after shifting each paired difference by the claimed practical-tolerance boundary

hypothesis_distinctness_evidence.decision_rule: True only when the selector's geometric flag is true; the multi-objective identity differs from both actual mode winners; its frozen accuracy and selection-time latency are between those winners within configured tolerances; and the two required effective median pairwise directions are independently established. This is verdict evidence, never reselection.

matched_aggregate_latency.aggregation: median across the six allocation-level candidate medians or allocation-level candidate p95 values

selector_geometric_distinct_compromise.reference_extremes: accuracy winner and unconstrained multi-objective-population latency extreme

analysis.ordering_claim_policy: The original preregistered paired-bootstrap classification is preserved for median and p95. Effective stable directions are separately emitted only when the one-sided exact shifted sign-flip test passes and all six paired differences are strictly beyond +/-0.73553775 ms. Lack of an effective direction is uncertainty, not equivalence. Every inference is pairwise-only; no simultaneous total order is claimed.

policy.bootstrap: paired percentile bootstrap resampling the six allocation-level differences with replacement
policy.equivalence_rule: Report practical equivalence when the complete paired 95 percent CI lies within the plus-or-minus practical tolerance band; otherwise report uncertainty.
policy.stable_difference_rule: Claim a relative latency direction only when the paired 95 percent CI lies wholly below negative practical tolerance or wholly above positive practical tolerance.

confidence_interval_role_by_policy.effective_erratum: descriptive only and never sufficient for an effective stable-direction claim
confidence_interval_role_by_policy.original_preregistered: controls the preserved per-comparison bootstrap classification
